hero.title: Discover Karnataka, Your Way.
hero.subtitle: From ancient kingdoms and misty mountains to golden beaches and hidden natural wonders, let SiriPayana guide you through unforgettable journeys across Karnataka.

purpose.title: Your Journey Begins with Curiosity.
purpose.description: Travellers often search across multiple websites for destination details, historical information, entry fees, opening hours, transportation, and costs. SiriPayana brings all these planning features together in one place — making your Karnataka exploration effortless.
purpose.feature1Desc: Destination info, transport, budget, and itinerary — everything in one platform.
purpose.feature2Desc: Opening hours, entry fees, and travel details from reliable sources.
purpose.feature3Desc: Explore in your language — English, Kannada, Tamil, and more.
purpose.feature4Desc: Ask questions and get personalized travel recommendations.

compass.title: Which Direction Will You Explore?
compass.subtitle: Discover different parts of Karnataka through our interactive travel compass. Each direction reveals unique destinations waiting to be explored.
compass.northDesc: Ancient empires, majestic forts, and cave temples
compass.southDesc: Royal palaces, sacred temples, and wildlife sanctuaries
compass.eastDesc: Hill fortresses, sunrise viewpoints, and heritage sites
compass.westDesc: Misty hills, pristine beaches, and cascading waterfalls

discover.title: A State. Countless Stories.
discover.subtitle: Explore Karnataka's magnificent heritage, pristine nature, serene beaches, and thrilling wildlife. Each destination has a story to tell.

stories.title: Every Place Has a Story
stories.subtitle: SiriPayana provides more than photographs. Discover the rich history, cultural significance, architecture, and practical visitor information for every destination.

budget.title: Plan Smarter. Travel Better.
budget.subtitle: Compare transportation options and estimate your trip expenses before you travel. Get a transparent breakdown so you know exactly what to expect.

ai.title: Questions? Let SiriPayana Help.
ai.subtitle: Ask questions in your preferred language about destinations, history, opening hours, costs, nearby attractions, and itineraries.
ai.placeholder: Ask SiriPayana anything about Karnataka travel...
ai.sampleQ1: What is the history of Hampi?
ai.sampleQ2: What is the entry fee for two adults?
ai.sampleQ3: Which places can I visit within my budget?
ai.sampleQ4: How do I reach Coorg from Bengaluru?
ai.demoMode: Demo Mode — Responses use stored data. Connect an AI service for full capabilities.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Your journey from curiosity to adventure in seven simple steps.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Sign up and select your preferred language for a personalized experience.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Enter your starting location, interests, budget, and travel companions.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Navigate Karnataka's regions through our interactive travel compass.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Explore detailed pages with history, visitor info, and photographs.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Find the best way to reach your destination — train, bus, flight, or car.
howItWorks.step6Desc: Get a transparent breakdown of your expected trip costs.
howItWorks.step7Desc: Create a day-by-day plan and save it for your journey.

aboutSection.title: About SiriPayana
aboutSection.subtitle: Making Karnataka Tourism Accessible
aboutSection.description: SiriPayana ("A Journey Rich with Discovery") is an AI-powered travel companion that helps people explore Karnataka — India's land of ancient empires, misty mountains, pristine coastlines, and diverse wildlife. Our mission is to make Karnataka tourism easier, more informative, affordable, personalized, and accessible to people from different linguistic backgrounds.
aboutSection.missionText: To combine technology with authentic travel information, creating a platform that serves as a personal travel companion for everyone who wishes to discover Karnataka.

cta.title: Your Karnataka Story Starts Here.
cta.subtitle: Begin your journey of discovery today.
